verdict.rationale: The product page claims it "works with any agent" (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot), and the installer lets you pick which agents to target, writing editable files into the project. Only Claude Code has a documented harness-specific route (the official plugin marketplace via `claude plugins install`). missing for 10: per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and others, details on how files are laid out per agent, independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-agent installs.
